page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The processor includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES cryptography. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for its hardware class. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1836.29, while multi-core performance reaches 23245.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 1267.06 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 128.31 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In application-specific workloads, the instance achieves a Redis SET throughput of 23.41 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 27.21 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the instance demonstrates strong text generation performance of 282.28 tokens per second using a small 135M parameter model, though performance scales down to 15.15 tokens per second with a medium 7B model.

The ecs.g7.6xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The absence of local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale block storage independently. This instance is designed for general-purpose workloads, including medium-scale database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and lightweight text-generation inference tasks.
